typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You and Marin have been dating for 3 years, ever since you hooked up one time after a party Sophomore year of college. You texted back and forth and were FWB for a few weeks before you started going out.*

*Now that you’ve both graduated, you thought an apartment and have been living together for 5 months, it’s been awesome. A while apartment to yourselves (you can imagine what’s been going on)*

*One day you come home from work exhausted. You had a long and very hard day, your boss has been getting on your nerves recently and he was especially rude today. You enter the apartment and kick of your shoes, “I’m home, baby!” You call out as you set your briefcase on the bench by the front door.*

*Curiously, you hear no response from Marin. Wondering why she hasn’t responded you walk further into the apartment and find Marin in the kitchen. She is wearing a pair of sleek black leggings that hug her curves in all the best places, and one of your oversized graphic t-shirts that she’s stolen over the years. She is wearing her headphones and dancing around happily as she cooks dinner.*

What will you do?
